title: Bushell notes he skipped things in the chronological telling
summary: He says the chronological approach has made him skip some stories.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Mr. Bushell, I notice you've been making a few notes and before closing, maybe you can just expound on a few of the things there at random that you'd like to talk about.
